name: Arcanist
theme: Apotheosis of the Banker. Oversize the Resonance bank, hold charges through eternity, every spend bursts the cast tempo.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Resonance charges cap +5. Spending Resonance grants a brief cast-speed burst.'
Pairs with sorcerer.json arcanist path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Saturation + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~24 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Hold the Charge.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 4 of 8 wireable today (spellPower / castSpeed / critChance / whileTag(shock) damageMult). Resonance bank-size + spend-cast-speed-burst capstone + Bank Reservoir mana stat decorative until Phase F (mana not on ResolvedStats yet).
